caveats: NWRC 2024: Figure 26 bar labels and its numeric table differ in places; the numeric table is used.
NWRC 2023: the printed December row repeats the annual totals, so December 2023 is marked not printed and year totals come from the report text.
Federal Territories are one combined reporting unit, kept in totals and tables but not split across territory polygons.
State ranks skip 2022 because that report gives only a national total.
The flow map and Sankey show the same 32 released animals; never sum them.
Bear events are cases described in public reports, not all BSBCC bears; Sika’s first mortality-signal date (5 Mar 2023) comes from the 2023 report text.
Placement durations are inclusive calendar days, not hours worked.
Animal GPS data and MyBIS data are excluded. Observation window: 2021–Jul 2026; reference map geometry exempt (2017 boundaries).
